decisions.reason: It fits the firm’s core automation and monitoring business, supports efficiency and energy-related optimization for infrastructure operators, and is the kind of application-oriented add-on an expanding German engineering firm would usually continue after only one year on the market.

A web-based weir-dimensioning tool complements the firm’s engineering and planning offer, strengthens early customer contact with municipalities and planners, and likely requires relatively modest resources to maintain within a broad digital portfolio.

A fouling detection system for heat exchangers is close to the firm’s established integrated solutions, matches its direction toward digitally networked asset monitoring, and would normally be retained while the firm is growing and investing in R&D-led product expansion.
